notes: cost_low_usd/cost_high_usd are filled ONLY from cited research (see sources[]). null = not yet researched or no reliable source. cost_confidence: cited | inferred | unverified | null.

findings.description: Front lower roof shingles loose/lifted, creased as though wind-bent
findings.requested_remedy: Roofing contractor to repair/secure all loose or lifted roof coverings prior to closing

options.contractor: Roofing company replaces creased/lifted shingles on front lower slope; $350-$1,500; 0.5 crew-day; notice names 'roofing contractor' so this is the required path
options.agent_as_contractor: Technically capable; HIGH documentation risk - notice specifies roofing contractor and requires receipts at re-inspection; not recommended
options.diy: Not viable - creased shingles need replacement and the notice requires a professional

findings.notes: Wind-crease language may support a homeowner's insurance wind-damage claim (offset, not pre-closing remedy)

findings.description: Roof sheathing weak/buckled in >=3 locations on left main upper roof, shingles lifting; visible from attic
findings.requested_remedy: Repair affected sheathing and restore roof covering attachment

options.contractor: Roofer opens affected areas, replaces est. 3-6 sheets ($100-$150/sheet installed) plus tear-off/re-shingle of 1-2 squares; hidden-damage upside risk once opened
options.agent_as_contractor: Same documentation risk as RS-1; structural-adjacent scope makes roofing-company receipts even more important

findings.notes: Inspector: commonly reconciled at failure or re-roof; buyers asked for repair now

findings.description: Kick-out flashings missing at wall/gutter transitions; dark wall staining indicates water flow
findings.requested_remedy: Install missing flashing and kick-out flashing to direct water into gutters

options.contractor: Retrofit kick-outs at 2-4 wall/gutter transitions; $250-$400/location standalone, lower bundled; can exceed band if siding must be rebuilt
options.agent_as_contractor: Marginally more defensible than RS-1/RS-2 but still under the 'roofing contractor' clause; not recommended
options.diy: Materials $10-$32/unit and physically DIY-able, but fails the notice's professional requirement

findings.description: Gutters/downspouts clogged in multiple areas; fasteners and hanger supports loose
findings.requested_remedy: Clean all gutters/downspouts, repair/secure fasteners and hangers, re-pitch as needed

options.contractor: Cleaning $70-275 + fastener/hanger repair $150-650; bundle with the roofer already on site
options.agent_as_contractor: Feasible - no trade license required for gutter work; produces the required invoice/receipt
options.diy: Technically trivial but likely fails the notice's 'qualified professional' + receipts requirement (INFERENCE)

findings.notes: Most DIY-viable item, but notice says qualified professional for agreed corrections

findings.description: Gutters sloped incorrectly, preventing proper drainage
findings.requested_remedy: Correct gutter/downspout slope for proper flow away from structure

options.contractor: Re-pitch/slope correction $75-300; usually absorbed into RS-4 re-hang scope
options.diy: Feasible but same notice-compliance tension as RS-4

findings.notes: Overlaps RS-4 scope; likely priced together

findings.description: Concrete chimney crown/cap damaged; water penetrating chimney/brick
findings.requested_remedy: Repair/replace chimney crown/cap and correct flashing

options.contractor: Repair path (partial crown rebuild + flashing reseal) $350-$1,400; full replacement + flashing $1,500-$3,500; may need chimney/masonry company - get scope agreed in writing
options.agent_as_contractor: Crown work is masonry - a chimney company receipt is the clean answer; not recommended

findings.description: Rear upper wood siding loose near roofline
findings.requested_remedy: Repair or replace damaged siding near roofline

options.contractor: Re-secure/replace small siding section near roofline; $150-$600 bundled with roof job, up to $750 standalone
options.agent_as_contractor: Most defensible item for the agent-contractor - siding arguably falls outside the 'roofing contractor' clause; confirm buyers will accept the receipt
options.diy: Physically trivial but notice requires professional completion

findings.description: 48-hr basement CRM test: EPA protocol average 13.6 pCi/L (action level 4.0)
findings.requested_remedy: Mitigate radon if level at or over 4.0 (triggered)

options.contractor: ONLY option - Ohio requires ODH-licensed radon mitigation contractor (ORC 3723.02). ASD system, 1-day install; 13.6 pCi/L below the ~20 design-escalation threshold, expect $1,000-1,800
options.agent_as_contractor: Not feasible unless agent holds an ODH radon mitigation license
options.diy: Not feasible for notice compliance - licensure required

findings.notes: Sub-slab depressurization typical; check ODH licensure requirement and post-mitigation retest timing vs 08/25 re-inspection

bundle.scope: RS-1+RS-2+RS-3+RS-6+EG-2 as one bundled roofing job (excl. gutters/radon)
bundle.notes: Composite of per-item cited bands adjusted for single-mobilization bundling; add ~$300-$800 for gutters (RS-4/RS-5) riding along and $1,000-$2,000 radon separately. ALL-IN ask (roof pkg + gutters + radon): ~$3,800-$10,200; most likely ~$5,500-$7,700. Chimney may add a second trade. First real Cincinnati quote supersedes.
